title: Slow English Podcast - The Giving Tree for Beginners (A1–A2)

header.titleZh: 慢速英語podcast - 初學者的捐贈樹 (A1–A2)
header.titleEn: Slow English Podcast - The Giving Tree for Beginners (A1–A2)

sentences.en: Welcome back to my Slow English podcast.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語podcast。

sentences.en: My favorite books. It's called The Giving Tree. Read slowly with me. The Giving Tree. Once there was a tree.
sentences.tc: 我最喜歡的書。這就是所謂的「捐贈樹」。跟我一起慢慢讀。捐贈樹。從前有一棵樹。

sentences.en: She loved a little boy. And every day the boy would come.
sentences.tc: 她愛著一個小男孩。男孩每天都會來。

sentences.en: He would gather all her leaves and make them into crowns and play the king of the forest.
sentences.tc: 他會收集她所有的葉子，把它們做成王冠，扮演森林之王。

sentences.en: He would climb up her trunk and swing from her branches and eat apples.
sentences.tc: 他會爬上她的樹幹，在她的樹枝上盪來盪去，吃蘋果。

sentences.en: He was tired,.
sentences.tc: 他累了，。

sentences.en: He would sleep in her shade. And the boy loved the tree very much. And the tree was happy. But time went by and the boy grew older and the tree was.
sentences.tc: 他會睡在她的樹蔭下。男孩非常喜歡這棵樹。樹很高興。但隨著時間的流逝，男孩長大了，樹也長大了。

sentences.en: My shade. And be happy.
sentences.tc: 我的影子。並保持快樂。

sentences.en: I am too big to climb and play, said the boy.
sentences.tc: 「我太大了，無法攀爬和玩耍，」男孩說。

sentences.en: I want to buy things and have fun.
sentences.tc: 我想買東西並玩得開心。

sentences.en: I want some money.
sentences.tc: 我想要一些錢。

sentences.en: Can you give me some money?
sentences.tc: 你能給我一些錢嗎？

sentences.en: I'm sorry, said the tree,.
sentences.tc: 對不起，樹說。

sentences.en: I have no money.
sentences.tc: 我沒有錢。

sentences.en: I have only leaves and apples. Take my apples, boy, and sell them in the city.
sentences.tc: 我只有樹葉和蘋果。孩子，把我的蘋果拿去城裡賣吧。

sentences.en: Then you will have money and you will be happy. And so the boy climbed up the tree and gathered her apples and carried them away. And the tree was happy.
sentences.tc: 然後你就會有錢，你就會幸福。於是男孩爬上樹，摘下她的蘋果，並把它們帶走。樹很高興。

sentences.en: The boy stayed away for a long time and the tree was sad.
sentences.tc: 男孩離開了很長一段時間，樹很難過。

sentences.en: Then one day the boy came back. The tree shook with joy.
sentences.tc: 然後有一天，男孩回來了。樹高興得搖晃起來。

sentences.en: She said, "Come, boy. Climb up my trunk and swing from my branches and be happy."
sentences.tc: 她說：“來吧，孩子。爬上我的樹幹，在我的樹枝上盪鞦韆，快樂吧。”

sentences.en: I am too busy to climb trees, said the boy.
sentences.tc: 「我太忙了，沒時間爬樹，」男孩說。
